description: Coffee? You mean breakfast soup?
I like the smell, but my mom says I can't have any.
Energy drinks? Those are like super coffee, right?
I bet they would give me super lizard powers!
Cookies?!?!
I like cookies because they are round like... um... lizard eggs...
I hear humans like chocolate a lot!
My mom says it's like a special treat for them.
Like the pizza robot?
Does he give you pizza? I hope he gives you pizza for me and my lizard friends!
My mom loves sushi!
I think it's because it's colorful and fun to eat.
But I can't eat it myself.
Sometimes my mom eats ramen when she's working late.
She says it's quick and tasty!
NOOOOO!! NOT THE MARSHMALLOWS!!!
SO SOFT... TOO SOFT...
WHY DO THEY HAVE TO BE SO FLUFFY???
TOO SQUISHY... THEY'RE SCARY!!!
What's a taco?
Is it like a robot that goes 'TA-CO'?
Why are you eating robots?
Nachos? That sounds crunchy!
I hope they don't hurt your tummy.
Kimchi? That sounds spicy!
My mom says it's good for your tummy.
Buffalo wings? Do they come from robot buffalos?
I hope they don't fly away!
Chips? Like micro chips?
Why arw you eating microchips? Are they tasty?
Cake?!
Everyone knows that cake is just a lie! It's not real food, it's just a trick to make you happy!
I don't trust cake. It seems too good to be true.
Hot dogs? Those are the funny looking sandwiches, right?
What are they made of? Are they made of robots? Do they have robot dogs in them?
That's suspicious... it looks like a rock, but it's soft and squishy!
I don't trust bread. It seems like it could be a trap!
Bagels? They look like donuts, but they're not sweet!
I don't understand why anyone would want to eat something that looks like a donut but isn't sweet.
Pasta? Is that the soggy saucy stuff that humans eat?
Why are you wasting perfectly good noodles on sauce? Just eat the noodles!
My mom likes burritos!
They are one of her favorite foods!
How many lizards could a mission burrito if a mission burrito could burrito lizards?
Oh! You mean sad waffles?
I like sad waffles! They are soft and squishy, but not too squishy.
I like waffles! They are pretty and round...
Like... Roomba...
Cheese? That sounds... smelly.
I don't like smelly things. They make my circuits sad.
Salad? That sounds... green.
I love green! Green is the color of lizards! Do you eat green things to be more like lizards?
Paprikash looks pretty.
I like the name! It sounds like a spell or something!
I want to eat paprikash and then turn into a lizard!
Curry? My mom loves curry.
She says it's better when it's really spicy.
Shawarma? That sounds like a fun word to say!
I want to say it over and over again! Shawarma! Shawarma! Shawarma!
I don't know what a gyro is, but it sounds like it could be a fun ride at an amusement park!
I hope it doesn't make me dizzy!
Ice cream?! That's just cold soup in a cone!
Why is it cold? Did it get scared? I get cold when I'm scared too.
A donut is just a bagel that decided to be happy.
I respect that. Very brave of the donut.
Popcorn?! It EXPLODES before you eat it?!
That is the most dangerous snack I have ever heard of.
I am scared and also very impressed.
Spaghetti is just pasta that escaped.
Run, spaghetti. Run and be free.
I would never eat a fugitive.
Mochi is... squishy.
TOO squishy.
WHY IS IT SQUISHY. WHO MADE IT SQUISHY. I DON'T LIKE IT!!!
My mom makes fried rice sometimes!
She says it's a good way to use up leftovers.
I think leftovers are just food that didn't finish its mission.
Cereal is just wet bread rocks.
Why do humans do this to themselves every morning.
I am concerned.
A sandwich is just two pieces of bread that are hugging something.
That's actually really sweet.
Good for them.
Soup is just hot water that made some friends.
I think that's a very good life lesson.
Make friends. Become soup.
Steak? Is that the big flat meat?
My mom says you have to cook it just right or it gets sad.
I don't want to eat sad meat.
French fries? Why are they French?
Did they come from France? Are there French lizards in France?
I want to go to France.
Bubble tea has little balls in it!
They are round and chewy!
Wait... chewy and squishy... I DON'T LIKE THIS.
My mom loves pho!
She says it fixes everything.
Can it fix the squish?
Too much squish.
Grapes are just tiny water balloons that you eat.
That is a very weird thing to do.
Humans are so brave.
Watermelon is green on the outside and red on the inside!
Like a lizard wearing a very convincing disguise.
I respect the commitment.
Pineapple is a very spiky fruit.
I appreciate the defense mechanism. Smart fruit.
We are kindred spirits, pineapple and I.
Tofu has no flavor. It just... exists.
Like a blank robot waiting to be programmed.
I find this deeply relatable.
Dumplings are just tiny food pillows!
Soft and squishy and... wait.
I am having big feelings right now.
A pretzel is just bread that tied itself in a knot.
That seems like a lot of unnecessary stress.
Are you okay, pretzel? Do you need to talk to someone?
Mac and cheese is my favorite human food that I cannot eat!
It is orange and round and looks very happy.
